yt_description:
Ever seen an algorithm do a little dance? 🕺 Prepare to be mesmerized by Cocktail Sort, also known as Bidirectional Bubble Sort! We're visualizing this unique sorting algorithm step-by-step, showing you exactly how it 'cocktails' your data into perfect order. Watch as it efficiently bubbles elements both forwards AND backwards! 🌊 Perfect for understanding sorting logic and a fun watch for any coder.
